reasoning: Vivek Ramaswamy announced his candidacy for Ohio Governor in early 2025. The Ohio gubernatorial election will be held in November 2026. As a Republican with national name recognition from his 2024 presidential campaign and subsequent role in the Trump administration (DOGE), he has significant advantages in the primary. However, he faces challenges: he's relatively new to Ohio politics, may face primary opposition, and would need to win the general election.
